result.note: Tests the July 2026 US additional duty on Indian goods and the textile quotas offered to Southeast and South Asian competitors.

questions.prompt: Consider the following statements about the trade measures announced by the United States in July 2026:
items: The United States imposed an additional 10% duty on Indian goods, citing forced-labour enforcement.
India was among the countries offered textile quotas by the United States.
Bangladesh, Cambodia, Indonesia and Malaysia were offered textile quotas.
questions.ask: Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.explain: Statement 2 is wrong because India was not offered a textile quota and must now negotiate its way into the arrangement. The quotas went to Bangladesh, Cambodia, Indonesia and Malaysia, while India faced an extra 10% duty over forced-labour enforcement.
questions.source: The United States imposed an additional 10% duty on Indian goods over forced-labour enforcement, while offering textile quotas to Bangladesh, Cambodia, Indonesia, and Malaysia that India must now negotiate its way into.
